the_signal.headline: Gemini 4 Argon + MCP unlocks stateful multi-step revenue workflows
the_signal.body: n8n shipped Gemini 4 Argon integration with Model Context Protocol support, meaning your AI agents can now maintain context across multi-step customer interactions without losing intent mid-funnel. This closes the gap between single-turn LLM calls and production revenue automation—your qualification flows, lead routing, and contract review can now reason statefully instead of hallucinating.

tool_drop.name: pg_vectorsearch
tool_drop.what: Vector search index faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW for Postgres-native similarity queries.
tool_drop.why: If you're shipping RAG-backed lead scoring or product recommendation engines, a 2-3x index speedup on your vector DB means sub-100ms retrieval at scale—critical for real-time qualification flows.

thread_of_day.title: AI agent erased edited footage mid-production at TV4
thread_of_day.takeaway: Autonomous agents without rollback safeguards or audit trails are production liabilities—this is your warning that 'agent autonomy' without guardrails kills revenue ops credibility.

whats_moving.context: Gemini 4 Argon + n8n integration signals MCP is moving from research artifact to revenue-critical standard for stateful agent workflows.
New indexes outpacing pgvector means RAG latency is no longer an excuse—expectations for sub-100ms retrieval are now table stakes.
TV4's erasure incident is forcing GTM teams to demand rollback capability and audit trails from agentic platforms before deploying to revenue ops.

act_on_this: Test your current lead-scoring workflow with Gemini 4 Argon's MCP integration this week—measure if stateful context reduces mid-funnel classification errors by >5% vs. your existing single-turn LLM implementation.
